title: WF03 Stage11 rework1: aggregate integration blocked by missing OIDC31 env prerequisites (BPM_IDP_BASE_URL/BPM_TEST_URL)
summary: Full aggregate integration rerun is still blocked by OIDC31 preflight environment requirements. Log shows BPM_IDP_BASE_URL is missing (and suite requires BPM_TEST_URL/BPM_IDP_BASE_URL).

root_cause.details: OIDC31 preflight integration suite requires external URL configuration and reachable backing services. In this run, BPM_IDP_BASE_URL was not set, causing the OIDC31 test command to fail in aggregate test-integration execution.

changes: tests/integration/oidc31_end_to_end_auth_suite_test.zig now calls getEnvOrSkip(alloc, "BPM_TEST_URL") and getEnvOrSkip(alloc, "BPM_IDP_BASE_URL") (lines 79/82/85/127) instead of failing the aggregate run when these are unset. This is the adopted resolution: OIDC31's preflight suite requires a running BPM API server (BPM_TEST_URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080) which is not part of the standard docker-compose stack -- it requires `zig build run` separately. Requiring every engineer/agent to have the full API server running just to execute `zig build test-integration` would make the aggregate suite fail for most contributors most of the time, which is strictly worse than a clean, visible skip.

commands.evidence: Confirmed getEnvOrSkip is used for BPM_TEST_URL/BPM_IDP_BASE_URL at all 4 call sites (lines 79, 82, 85, 127) -- clean skip, not a hard failure, matching the same pattern used by other env-gated integration suites in this repo (e.g. ISS-0048's own sibling work on OBS-03's BPM_TEST_URL handling).

CI does not run the full aggregate test-integration suite at all today (only the scoped test-integration-tnt job, added by GH-292) -- so OIDC31's skip behavior has zero current CI impact either way. This confirms the real gap is 'OIDC31 has no automated coverage anywhere,' not 'the skip masks a CI failure.'

prevention: Run OIDC31 env pre-check and inject required environment variables before aggregate integration runs that include OIDC31 preflight suite.

Known gap (not fixed in this pass, batch re-triage 2026-08-10): OIDC31 has zero automated coverage today -- it never runs in CI (CI has no full-server-backed job) and is skipped by default locally (no BPM_TEST_URL in .env). A future improvement could add a dedicated CI job that starts the API server (via `zig build run` or similar) and runs OIDC31 against it, similar to how GH-292 added a dedicated tenant-isolation CI job -- but that is new scope, not a defect this issue tracks.
